relationships.subject: nociceptin
relationships.evidence_quote: An inhibitory effect of nociceptin in oligodendrocyte maturation and myelinating activity is further supported by the observation that in vivo inhibition of NOR signaling results in accelerated myelination.

relationships.subject: mu-opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of the high affinity mu-opioid receptor by low buprenorphine concentrations results in stimulation of oligodendrocyte maturation

relationships.subject: buprenorphine
relationships.evidence_quote: In remarkable contrast, elevated drug concentrations (3 μM) block oligodendrocyte maturation, an inhibitory effect mediated by concomitant buprenorphine-dependent activation of the nociceptin/orphanin FQ receptor (NOR).

relationships.subject: methadone
relationships.evidence_quote: oligodendrocyte maturation is also stimulated by the mu-opioid receptor agonist methadone53.

key_findings: Review: opposing mu-opioid receptor and nociceptin receptor signaling control timing of oligodendrocyte maturation and myelination.
Low buprenorphine and methadone accelerate, high buprenorphine blocks, oligodendrocyte maturation.
